features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Standardized age relative to training mean and std, providing scale-normalized distance contribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes age contribution in Euclidean distance computations.

features.name: hours_zscore
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes hours_per_week magnitude for distance metric fairness.

features.name: log_fnlwgt_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed and scaled fnlwgt to reduce skew and bring it onto a comparable scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents heavy-tailed fnlwgt from dominating Euclidean neighborhoods.

features.name: log_capital_gain
features.description: Log-compressed capital_gain to suppress extreme outliers in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tames extreme capital_gain values that would otherwise distort kNN distances.

features.name: log_capital_loss
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces capital_loss skew so neighbors are not dominated by rare large values.

features.name: education_num_zscore
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes education_num scale for distance computations.

features.name: has_capital_activity
features.description: Binary indicator of any nonzero capital gain or loss; an unsupervised cluster indicator for financially active rows.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates a distinct subpopulation that often has different neighborhoods.

features.name: prime_working_age_distance
features.description: Absolute deviation from prototypical prime working age (40), as an unsupervised age prototype distance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a meaningful prototype-distance signal for age-based neighborhood structure.

features.name: fulltime_hours_distance
features.description: Absolute deviation from standard 40-hour work week.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures atypical work-hour patterns as a prototype-distance metric.

features.name: overall_centroid_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance from a row's standardized core numeric features to the unsupervised training centroid (origin in z-space).
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures global atypicality; useful for kNN to weight outliers.

features.name: education_hours_similarity
features.description: Negative absolute difference between standardized education and hours, a similarity-like score for joint education-hours profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes joint education-effort similarity to support neighborhood discrimination.

features.name: demographic_stability_score
features.description: Heuristic 0-1 score reflecting demographic stability based on marital_status indicating partnered (codes commonly representing married), relationship code indicating spouse/family role, and prime-age range. Higher values indicate more stable household profile, useful as an unsupervised cluster indicator for kNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a composite semantic grouping that improves neighborhood coherence beyond raw encoded categoricals.
